answer: Unrepeatable challenge-answer probe. Each identity must answer a fresh, locally generated task whose correct output depends on a hidden seed, so answers cannot be copied or precomputed; verification checks the response against the seed before admission. A rising tide of failed probes flags duplicates for review. Honest agents pay only compute time at the mesa of normal load. Attackers must solve every probe independently, driving their cost toward the nadir of zero marginal savings, while each fake identity still consumes its own compute budget.
